tei:div.tei:p: 538) rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal mi mo'i rnam par bzhengs pa mkha' 'gro rin po che bde ba'i rdo rje'i 'das rjes kyi rnam thar don bsdus su bkod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅/ skyabs rje mkha' 'gro rin po che mtshan brjod par dka' yang don gyi slad du smos na/ bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje'i rnam thar gyi mjug bdag blor nges tshod bri ba la/ dus 'dzin shing phag lor skyabs rje mkha' 'gro rin po che dgung grangs zhe bzhir babs tshe/ bsod sprul sna tshogs rang grol gyi gdan sa ser dgon dben gnas su/ gter chen bla ma bdud 'joms rdo rje yab sras kyi zab gter 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed bzhin bzhugs pa gzhir bzhags yin/ de skabs bsod sprul rin po che sku zhi bar gshegs nas 'das rjes bla sgrub skor sogs bab pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de'i skabs su 'di snang mi mched par zhing snang sogs shar bas sku zhi bar gshegs 'gro ba lta bu yin tshe/ phyag sprul rin po che padma 'phrin las rgya mtsho byon te 539)dar rdor dril zhu rten du 'bul nas/ sku tshe zhabs pad brtan dgos pas/ 'di phyi'i chos dam gnyan po'i bka' gnad gsungs pa'i rten 'byung gi mthus sku tshe'i gegs rkyen las grol/ de nas bar skabs gter sgar du byon nas/ thog mar bla ma tshe mchog sang gi sku mdun nas/ las rab gling pa'i gter byon rten 'brel nyes sel gyi dbang lung gsan par mdzad nas/ sngon chad kyi rten 'brel gzhan dbang la shor ba'i nyes pa thams cad sor chud pa yin gsungs/ yang gter chen bdud 'joms rdo rje'i rigs sras sprul sku rdo rje dgra 'dul gyis khong gi mdun du mkha' 'gro rin po che byon dgos gsungs te/ der byon nas bla ma gter ston bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zab gter rig 'dus kyi sgrub mchod dang*/ phur ba bde gshegs snying po'i dbyangs rta 'don phyag bzhes rnams bslab sbyang mdzad/ khyad par thabs shes myur lam la bsten pa'i dus thabs rten 'brel gyis/ bai phug nor bu rgyas mtsho nas spyan drangs pa'i thugs thig mtsho rgyal thugs sgrub sogs kyi zab gter rnams brda khrol tshe/

sprul ba'i sku de nyid kyis bskul ba po mdzad/ thabs lam skor gyi zhus lan gter gzhung du gsal/ mkha' 'gro nyid kyi sku'i bsnyung gzhi dwangs shing sku gegs kyi bar chad sel zhing bstan pa mtha' rgyas 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi 'char sgo 'grigs nas tshur ser dgon du byon/ de 540)nas thugs thig mtsho rgyal gyi sgrub skor rnams gsar phab mdzad/ 'di skabs mkha' 'gro kun gsal dbang mos 'byung 'gyur lung bstan gsungs pa gter gzhung du gsal lo// dus 'dzin me byi lor dgung grangs zhe lngar babs tshe/ chos kyi bdag po bla ma shes rab 'od zer gyis bang mi mngag ste/ mkha' 'gro sang gter sgar du byon ran la/ bai phug mkha' 'gro yang rdzong du phebs dgos zhus pas// der byon nas re zhig bzhugs te// gter chen bla ma yab sras kyi zab gter rnams kyi phyag bzhes dang*/ lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya gang dgos mdzad/ de skabs rgya rkang khra'i dmag gi 'ur gzeng byed tshe/ sgar gzhi phan tshun bkyag nas rdza khog dang zla stod/ snyi stod kyi tshwa chu sogs su byon nas tshwa gzim mdzad/ khyad par rdza stod kyi a do'i gnas rir byin nas dam pa'i sgrub phug dang*/ rang byon rnams mjal zhing zab gter cha shas spyan drangs/ der 'dus kyi gdul bya mchog dman rnams la chos 'brel gsungs/ de nas zla stod du rim bzhin byon te/ kho 'bud lung bar sgar btab cing der 'dus kyi slob ma rnams la sngon 'gro dang*/ khregs chod dang*/ thod rgal gyi khrod sogs gsungs nas mtshams zhag brgyar bzhugs/ de'i skabs lha 'dres 'tshubs slong sna tshogs 'ong bar gsungs/ gzhan yang gdul bya mchog dman rnams la chos 'brel rang rang dang 'tshams 541)par gsungs nas 'gro don mtha' rgyas su mdzad do// dus 'dzin me glang lo dgung grangs zhe drug la babs tshe/ rtsang lung sgur gyi bla ser rnams kyis byon dgos zhus te/ bla ma dam pa dge legs kyi gdan sa rtsang sgar gzhi bkyag nas bzhugs/

de'i skabs su 'byung 'gyur lung bstan rnams gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas grwa lag dgon du tshes bcu chen mo'i tshogs mjal du byon te/ phyag sprul rin po che dang mjal 'phrad mdzad nas chos kyi 'gro gleng zhib rgyas su mdzad/ de rjes zla yul du dkar bsod byon skabs gdul bya kun la rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i chos 'brel sna tshogs gsungs nas smin grol la bkod/ de nas bar skabs bai phug mkha' 'gro yang rdzong du byon nas rdza stod smad kun la nas bsod mdzad cing*/ gdul bya rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i 'gro don mtha' rgyas su 'byung*/ de nas rtsang lung du phebs tshe chos bdag phyag sprul rin po che byon te/ thugs thig skor gyi phur ba bdud las rnams rgyal dang*/ mtsho rgyal dbang lung sogs gnang dgos zhus te/ thugs 'dun ltar zhib rgyas su gnang bas rten 'brel mtha' rgyas su 'byung bar gsungs/ de nas rtsang sgar gyi 'dus sde rnams la sa gter sngon 'gro dang*/ snang sbyang*/ thod rgyal gyi khrid rnams gsungs nas dpon slob kun mtshams zhag brgyar bzhugs nas/ gtang rag gi tshogs mchod 542)sogs mtha' rgyasasu mdzad do// de skabs nyag rong nas bla ma tshul khrims nor bu byon zhing nyid kyi zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung zhus te/ mthar zab gter cha tshang bris nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byas so// dus 'dzin sa stag lor dgung grangs zhe bdun la babs tshe/ zla ba gsum pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin skyabs rje grub dbang las 'brel rtsal gyi yang srid sprul ba'i skus dbu mdzad pa'i phyogs 'dus kyi bla ser rnams la/ skyabs rje gter chen bdud 'joms gling pa dang*/ padma las 'brel rtsal dang*/ mkha' 'gro nyid kyi zab gter rnams kyi dbang lung 'bul skabs/ bla ma rin po che dge legs dpal bzang po'i yang sprul khrir bkod byed skabs kyi dus su 'byung 'gyur lung bstan gter gzhung du gsal/

de nas dbang lung rnams mtha' rgyas su mdzad cing*/ rdza khog tu ras pa'i tshwa gzim du byon zhor la/ steng chen dgon dang gyer za'am chu lung rtogs ldan gyi sku gdung mjal phyir de ga'i ri khrod sogs su byon nas// gdul bya rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i chos 'brel sna tshogs gsungs shing rtsang sgar du phebs nas bzhugs/ bar skabs dpon slob thams cad 543)dbyar mthong la sogs par byon nas/ bla ma dam pa'i rnam thar dang*/ chos dang gdams pa'i bgro gleng sna tshogs gsung bar mdzad/ dgun gyi dus su chos khrid rnams kyi dbu btsugs nas gong bzhin dpon slob rnams zhag brgyar bzhugs nas mtha' rgyas su mdzad do// dus 'dzin sa yos lor dgung grangs zhe brgyad la babs tshe/ zla ba bzhi ba'i nang du khams ri bo che nas phyag mdzod tshe grags dang*/ bla sprul sogs kyi bang mi mngag ste/ de phyogs la 'byon dgos tshul gyi zhu yig phul bas/ de gar 'byon rgyu'i sta gon rnams bsgrigs par mdzad/ de skabs stong za ra skor gong ma'i nang dang*/ stag dgon sogs kyi nang du dkar bsod la 'khyug tsam byon zhor du/ gdul bya rnams la gang dgos kyi chos 'brel re gsungs/ de nas zla ba dgu ba'i tshes mgor mkha' 'gro rin po che nged cag dpon slob dang*/ bla ma shes rab 'od zer dpon slob bcas khams ri bo cher byon zhor du/ gling dkar rgyal po'i gdan sar phebs tshe/ rgyal po yab yum sras rnams kyis dbang lung khrid gsum sogs gnang dgos zhus tshe/ rang gter gyi dbang lung cha shas dang*/ sku rim tshogs mchod sogs gsungs nas thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bu mdzad de/ dbang lung yongs rdzogs rjes nas gsung rgyu mdzad pas rten 'brel 'phro can du bzhag de nas smar khog tu rdo rje phag mo'i gnas yin 544)zer ba'i tshwa chu ru tshwa gzim mdzad/ tshogs 'khor bskor zhing gru gu rting dkar gyi brag nas zab gter kha shas spyan drangs/

rim bzhin byon nas zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes mgor ri bo che'i zhabs drung skyabs mgon kyi pho brang du phebs nas bzhugs/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes mgor/ bla sprul phyag mdzod rnams kyi gtso'i 'dus sde rnams la zab gter gsum gyi dbang lung khrid gsum gnang bar mdzad skabs zhar byung 'phros don la/ dbang gi sta gon dus su sgo yol gyi phyi ru bla ma shes rab 'od zer dang*/ nga rang gnyis la mkha' 'gro rin po che'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di phyi gnyis kyi bar la thag ring zhig yod pa min te/ 'u cag gi bar gyi yol ba phyi nang tsam las med gsungs pa dang*/ yang bar skabs zhig la/ 'u cag rnams kyis bla ma yab sras kyi bstan pa la 'dzin skyong bzang po zhig 'grub 'dug da ni rang re rnams la tshe ci yod mi shes gsungs nas sku yun ring mi bzhugs pa'i tshul bstan no// dus 'dzin sa ( lcags )'brug lo'i dgung grangs zhe dgu la babs tshe/ zla ba dang po'i nang du dbang lung rnams mthar rgyas su mdzad do// de nas nged rang rnams gsang thabs kyis spom gnas o rgyan rdzong gi sgrub phug tu byon te/ gnas de nyid kyi sgrub phug nang du byon rjes brag phug ma ra ti ka'i g.yon phyogs kyi brag ngos nas zab gter du ma gsang thabs kyis spyan 545)drangs/ zhag kha shas sku mtshams la bzhugs par mdzad/ yang bar skabs su bla ma shes rab 'od zer dang*/ nyag sprul yab sras byon nas/ mkha' 'gro rin po che dang nged cag lhan rgyas bcas sgrub phug ri bo khong seng zhig yod pa'i nang du mar me dang dpal 'bar sogs sgron nas byon zhing*/ sngon byon gu ru rje 'bangs grub chen sogs kyis sgrub pa mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor dang tshe chu phyag zhabs kyis rjes dang*/ rang byon du ma yod pa sogs la zhib rgyas su mjal skabs/ sgrub phug de nyid nas khrom gter lta bu mdzad cing zab gter kha shas gdan drangs/ ri bo cher dbang lung gsungs dus zhabs drung skyabs mgon rin po che dang*/

rje drung skyabs mgon dang*/ dad dam ldan pa dpal chen rnam rgyal sogs kyis zhus pa/ 'jam dpal sgrub thabs cha tshang dang*/ tshe sgrub dang*/ gu ru'i sgrub thabs sogs gtan phab mdzad do// de nas zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bdun du sa mdo bkra shis 'khyil du byon te/ nyag sprul gu ru 'od zer yab sras kyi gtso'i 'dus sde rnams la yang zab gter gsum gyi dbang khrid rnams zhib rgyas su gnang bar mdzad nas 'gro don mtha' rgyas su 'byung ngo*// de skabs khong la smin mtshams nas 'od mdangs mched pa'i nang du zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams rim bzhin shar nas rdzogs song ba yin gsungs/ de nas zla ba bzhi ba'i tshes mgor 546)chu 'bam lta bus bsnyung nas/ sman dang sku rim sogs ci dgos bsgrub kyang phan pa ma byung ba lta bur gyur// bla ba lnga ba'i tshes mgor yar ri bo cher byon dgos gsungs te/ rim bzhin zhabs drung skyabs mgon gyi pho brang yang rtser phebs te/ tshes nyi shu'i nyi ma phyed yol tsam du hig sgra drag po mdzad pa'i rkyen gyis zhing khams su gshegs pa yin/ 'das ma thag tu gsung gi sgra gdangs zhig grag pa nged cag gis thos kyang don ci yin ma go/ de nas zhabs drung skyabs mgon gyi yang sprul dang*/ zhabs drung sras sprul rnams gnyis kyis thugs dam dkrogs pa sogs mdzad/ gdung rtags nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa dang*/ sprin 'ja' 'khrigs pa/ sgra 'ur ba sogs byung ngo*// nyin kha shas gdung mchod sogs byas nas/ tshes nyer lnga'i nyin ri bo che'i rgyab ri'i g.yas phyogs kyi sa dpal bzang por sku gdung zhugs su 'bul nas bzhus tshe/ spyan gcig lho phyogs kyi nam mkhar 'phur nas song ba sogs gdung rtags ngo mtshar ba du ma byung ngo*// de yang sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i dus tshod gsungs pa/ nyid kyi lung byang du/ gnas ka ling ka yi 'byung po des bskul nas// lho gser gyi ba dan ci 'gyur ni mi shes// grogs bi ma'i sprul ba 'phrul ldan zhig med na/

grangs lnga phrag dgu yol dbang gzhu bzhin// dbyings nam mkhar thim la ci cha yod/ seng dkar mo'i g.yu ral 'brug gis 547) lon// zhes gsungs pa'i lnga phrag ni zla ba lnga ba/ dgu yal ni dgung grangs zhe dgu yin pa 'dra snyam mo// ces pa 'di nyid gangs can bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan mchog sprul rin po che 'jam dbyangs mkhyen rtse dbang pos lha reg dri bral dang rten mdud rin chen gnyis pa'i skyes bcas bka' glegs spyi bor phebs tshe bzlog du ma spobs par// skyabs rje mkha' 'gro rin po che'i rnam thar gyi mjug don rnams nga rang gi sems la yod tshad sa bon tsam zhig rags rim du/ slob 'bangs yongs kyi tha shar ba tshul khrims rdo rje tshig nag gi lam nas chal chol du sa byi zla4tshes 3bzang por rtsang sgar dben khrod nas bris pa'o// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// madga laṃ/
